purpose: Fixed retrospective common-cohort Ridge feature ablation: water/management context versus context plus measured cover growth
exposure: Designed after inspecting all previous contrast outcomes and the same trial's published biomass/rainfall analysis. Settings fixed before this experiment. Historical development evidence, not an independent final test.
cohort: Exactly the 68 existing joint-water/yield pairs, 20 shared controls and five paired whole-season folds; no extra yield-only rows or missing-value imputation
interaction: biomass_rain_kg_mm_ha = measured cover_biomass_kg_ha * exact wheat-sowing-through-harvest season_rain_mm; raw product, no threshold or transformation search
preprocessing: ColumnTransformer inside Pipeline: StandardScaler(with_mean=True,with_std=True) on numeric columns; OneHotEncoder(drop=None,handle_unknown=ignore,sparse_output=False) on both categories. Fit entirely on each training fold; full one-hot coding is regularized symmetrically by Ridge. No target encoding or imputation.
primary: Equal-season MAE of context_biomass against context and frozen direct water-only Ridge
secondary: All reference errors, pooled MAE/RMSE/bias, control-balanced MAE, season/management slices, benefit/harm recall and confusion counts, balanced decision accuracy, observed paired yield opportunity loss, per-season average precision where both classes exist
decision: Same 1e-12 numerical zero and choose-fallow-on-tie diagnostic as cover_fallow_protocol_v1; no threshold tuning or calibrated probabilities
interpretation: Lower magnitude error alone is insufficient: inspect benefits identified and harmful cover choices. Adding biomass is a two-feature family increment. Original-model versus context differences change multiple representation choices, not a causal single-variable ablation.
restrictions: No nitrate or 123-row sensitivity in this primary run
No confidence intervals treating repeated controls/folds as independent
Measured sowing water, cover biomass and realized weather are future intermediates at cover planting
No farmer readiness, serving refit, payload changes or model promotion
